list.name: browser_selector
list.label: 浏览器流选择器（接入时核验）

list.name: tg_platform
list.label: 设备/客户端平台
list.query: 全部 : .*,iOS : ios,Android : android|android_x,桌面Telegram : macos|tdesktop|unigram,Telegram Web : web|weba|webk,未知或历史未分层 : unknown|other|^$

list.name: net_type
list.label: 网络有效等级
list.query: 全部 : .*,4g速度级 : 4g,3g速度级 : 3g,2g或更慢 : 2g|slow-2g,窗口起止变化 : mixed,未知或历史未分层 : unknown|other|^$

options.content:
**待 TEST Cloud 接入验证；不是线上验收完成。** 本机已核验固定版本 Faro → Alloy → Loki 的日志字段。Cloud 托管浏览器入口需再核对实际流标签/格式，browser_selector 不得凭空猜测。无数据不等于0次失败。按同环境、版本、入口、网络/平台层比较，成功P50/P95与终态样本量一起看；低样本只观察，不自动排名或作人员考核。默认24h/5min，避免高频长窗查询。

开始/终态按窗口计数，**不是逐请求闭环或全访问覆盖**（无身份关联，窗口边界和丢报可影响结果）。先观察24–48h基线，再审核预算；后台、离页和主动停止单列。

page.ready=挂载后可用；page.launch=文档开始→可用；page.navigation=已捕获导航起点→可用，三者不混用。首页通用ready是目录/可用播放器状态，播放启动另看短剧。未知程序式导航只标mount。缓存可用和网络刷新分开。

**分层比较：** 设备/客户端按Telegram平台归类，不采集具体机型；网络是浏览器估算的有效速度等级，不是Wi-Fi/蜂窝类型。iOS等不支持时为unknown，不能视为弱网。默认全部保留历史缺标签；具体筛选只看对应样本。普通测量取入队时网络；播放窗口取起点，起止不同标mixed，不证明整窗稳定。

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_started" | logfmt | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_started" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" [$__range]))

panels.title: 已知页面终态成功率（不含离页/后台）
panels.description: ready/(ready+error)，不是所有真实访问成功率。

targets.expr: (sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_terminal" | logfmt | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_outcome="ready" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_terminal" | logfmt | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_outcome=~"ready|error" [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_ready" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_ready" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route,context_navigation_type)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_ready" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_ready" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route,context_navigation_type)

quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_launch" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_launch" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_launch" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_launch" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

panels.title: 网络刷新完成（不与缓存可用混算）

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_fresh" | logfmt | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_fresh" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="fresh" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route)

panels.title: 页面全部终态样本（供分母检查）

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_route,event_data_outcome,event_data_navigation_type) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_terminal" | logfmt | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_net_type=~"$net_type" | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" [$__range]))
